Satellite money orders
*241. SHRI C. P. THIRUNAVU-
KKARASU: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Department of Posts
has achieved the expected traffic of satellite
money orders;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(c) what steps Government are taking
to improve the traffic of satellite money
order transfer?
New system of recruitment for All
India Services
*242. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the method
of recruitment to the All India Services is
set to undergo a major revision;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether the new system would take
into account the special requirements for
the millennium leading to an era of a new
generation of reforms; and
(d) by when the new selection process
is likely to be put in place?
Steps for preservation of food
*243. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Food
Corporation of India was established for
the preservation of food;
(b) if so, whether the Food Corporation
of India has not been able to achieve the
objective;
(c) if so, whether Government are
considering to take some steps for the
preservation of food; and
(d) if so, by when and the details thereof
and if not, the reasons therefor?

74
WIN2\SESSION\3747RS 74
Implementation of ESIC
Programme
*244. SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be pleased
to state:
(a) the steps taken by the Employees
State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) to
implement the programme it had drawn up
for the Golden Jubilee year;
(b) what is the aggregate amount the
insurers are to get as on the 31st March,
2001;
(c) what amount would be disbursed
during the Golden Jubilee year; and
(d) how many model hospitals would be
set up on the basis of the programme?
Sanction of Telephone towers
*245. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the towers for
giving telephone connectivity and television
facility particularly to Parvati Valley and
other connected areas in Kullu District,
Ashapuri Valley and other connected areas
in Kangra District in Himachal Pradesh were
sanctioned during 1994 to 1996 by the
Department of Telecommunications;
(b) whether foundation was also
completed during that period; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and what
action has been taken or proposed to be
taken to complete the projects and if no
action has been taken so far, the reasons
therefor?
Underworld dons
*246. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that UAE
Government is not co-operating in dealing
with the Indian underworld dons who
have made Dubai their base for so many
years;
(b) if so, Government’s views and
reaction thereto; and
(c) the details of the action taken or
proposed to be taken in this regard?
Indo-Russian joint venture
*247. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether India and Russia are
launching a number of joint ventures for
manufacturing telecom equipments and
optic fibres;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the work on the projects
is likely to commence?

75
WIN2\SESSION\3747RS 75
PoW lodged in Kot Lakhpat Jail
*248. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMAD
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have refused
to accept 51 PoW, lodged in Kot Lakhpat
Jail in Pakistan, 32 of whom have been
declared as internees after completing their
jail terms awarded by various Pakistani
courts;
(b) if so, whether Government have also
refused to accept ashes of 21 cremated
Indian Prisoners of War lying in the Kot
Lakhpat Jail; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor?
Handing over of NH-52 to BRO
*249. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has been decided to hand
over National Highway-52 to the Border
Roads Organisation;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor, the date
of decision and actual execution;

Agro-based Industries in Assam
1810. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the type of Agro-based industries
visualised in the North-Eastern States
including Assam;
(b) how many of these industries have
been established in these States including
Assam; and
(c) the amount invested by the Central
Government in these States, industry-wise?
Irradiation processing of food
1811. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that irradiation
processing of food would help the country
save Rs. 25,000 crore worth foodgrains;
(b) if so, whether Government have not
so far followed such a process; and
(c) whether the Bhabha Atomic Research
Centre has submitted any proposal in this
regard?
Generation of nuclear power
1812. SHRI P. N. SIVA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have prepared
a plan to increase generation of nuclear
power in the next twenty years;
(b) if so, whether any details have been
worked out with regard to setting up of more
nuclear power plants; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Post office recurring deposit claims
1813. MISS FRIDA TOPNO: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that claimants can
receive the benefit of Post Office Recurring
Deposit cases of missing persons after
waiting for the mandatory period of seven
years;
(b) if so, whether any such claims are
pending for settlement from July, 2001 till
date in Delhi;
(c) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the reasons for not setting these claims;

delay in some cases even when all

(e) if so, Government’s reaction thereto;

(f) by when these claimants would

Postal buildings in H.P.
1814. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that foundation
stone was laid by Government for
construction of Postal buildings at BHIULI
area in Mandi Town, Himachal Pradesh
between 1993 and 1995, if so, the details
thereof; and
(b) what action Government have taken
or purpose to take in the matter?
Recovery  of  revenue  from
unauthorised wireless users
1815. SHRI S. RAMACHANDRAN
PILLAI: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have failed to recover revenue amounting to
Rs. 2481 crore from 6435 unauthorised
wireless users including VSNL for period
ranging from one to eighteen years;
(b) whether it is also a fact that no action,
as provided in the India Telegraph Act, was
taken against such users;
(c) if so, the reasons for not taking any
action;
(d) what action has been taken to recover
the dues; and
(e) the results thereof?
Out of order public telephones in
Gujarat
1816. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of out of order public
telephones in the rural areas of Gujarat;
(b) the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
make them functional?
Telephone revenue arrears
1817. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Telephone revenue
arrears of DoT have increased as comapred
to the previous year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for increase in arrears;
and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
revcover the arrears?
Refusal to provide funds for rural
telephone facilities

MISHRA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Finance
Ministry has turned down the demand of
Bharat Sanchar Nigam for Rs. 2500 crores
to make available telephone facilities in the
villages;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Finance Ministry has also refused to grant
the amount of Licence fee received from the
Companies and service charges on the
